headings: FDA's premarket clearance and approval requirements
Premarket approval (PMA) and Humanitarian Device Exemption (HDE) pathways
paragraphs: We are a global oncology company with a proprietary platform technology called Tumor Treating Fields ("TTFields"), which are electric fields that exert physical forces to kill cancer cells. Our therapy is delivered through a medical device. Our key priorities are to drive commercial adoption of Optune Gio®, Optune Lua®, and Optune Pax®, our commercial TTFields therapy devices, obtain regulatory approval to market TTFields therapy devices in new indications, such as brain metastases from non-small cell lung cancer ("NSCLC"), and to advance clinical and product development programs intended to extend overall survival in some of the most aggressive forms of cancer.

Optune Gio is approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") under the Premarket Approval ("PMA") pathway for the treatment of adult patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma ("GBM") together with temozolomide, a chemotherapy drug, and for adult patients with GBM following confirmed recurrence after chemotherapy as monotherapy treatment. We also have a CE certificate to market Optune Gio for the treatment of GBM in the European Union ("EU"), as well as approval or local registration in the United Kingdom ("UK"), Japan, Canada and certain other countries.

Optune Lua is approved by the FDA under the PMA pathway for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic NSCLC concurrent with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors or docetaxel following progression on or after a platinum-based regimen. We also have a CE certificate to market Optune Lua concurrent with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors or docetaxel following progression on or after a platinum-based regimen for the treatment of metastatic NSCLC in the EU. In addition, we received regulatory approval for Optune Lua for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable advanced/recurrent NSCLC concurrent with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors following progression on or after a platinum-based regimen in Japan.

Optune Lua is also approved by the FDA under the Humanitarian Device Exemption ("HDE") pathway for the treatment of adult patients with malignant pleural mesothelioma or pleural mesothelioma (together, "MPM") together with standard chemotherapies. We have also have a CE certificate in the EU and approval or local registration to market Optune Lua for the treatment of MPM in certain other countries.

Optune Pax is approved by the FDA under the PMA pathway for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced pancreatic cancer concurrent with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel. We are pursuing regulatory approval to market Optune Pax in other countries.

We market our Products in multiple countries around the globe with the majority of our revenues coming from the use of Optune Gio in the U.S., Germany, France and Japan. We are actively evaluating opportunities to expand access to Optune Gio, Optune Lua and Optune Pax in additional international markets.

We have established coverage policies with both public and private payers for the use of Optune Gio in our active markets. We are actively pursuing coverage policies with payers to expand access to Optune Lua and Optune Pax and in the meantime we will bill and seek reimbursement from payers on an individual case basis, as applicable.

In September 2025, we presented final data from the Phase 3 METIS clinical trial evaluating the use of TTFields therapy and best supportive care (BSC) for the treatment of adult patients (n=298) with 1-10 brain metastases from NSCLC following stereotactic radiosurgery at the 2025 American Society for Radiation Oncology Annual Meeting. The primary endpoint of the METIS trial was defined as the time to intracranial progression (TTIP), as measured from the date of first SRS treatment to intracranial progression or neurological death, whichever occurred first. When accounting for competing risks using the Fine–Gray method, patients treated with TTFields therapy and BSC experienced a 28% lower risk of intracranial progression compared to those receiving BSC alone (HR=0.72, p=0.044). The median time to intracranial progression was 15.0 months in patients treated with TTFields therapy and BSC compared to 7.5 months in patients treated with BSC alone.
In December 2025 we submitted the final module of the PMA, seeking approval under the proposed brand name Optune Mya®. The PMA has been accepted as filed by the FDA, and is under substantive review.

We believe the physical mode of action behind TTFields therapy and resulting downstream cellular processes initiated by the damaged cells may be broadly applicable to solid tumor cancers. We have several ongoing and recently concluded clinical trials which further explore the use of TTFields therapy, including the Phase 3 TRIDENT
and KEYNOTE D58 trials in GBM, Phase 3 LUNAR-2 trial in NSCLC, and Phase 2 PANOVA-4 trial in pancreatic cancer.

We have several product development programs underway that are designed to optimize the delivery of TTFields to the target tumor and enhance patient ease of use. Our intellectual property portfolio contains hundreds of issued patents and numerous patent applications pending worldwide. We believe we possess global commercialization rights to our Products in oncology and are well-positioned to extend those rights into the future as we continue to find innovative ways to improve our Products.

In 2018, we granted Zai Lab (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. ("Zai") a license to commercialize our Products in China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan ("Greater China") under a License and Collaboration Agreement (the "Zai Agreement"). The Zai Agreement also establishes a development partnership intended to accelerate the development of TTFields therapy in multiple solid tumor cancer indications. For additional information, see Note 12 to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

Our ordinary shares are quoted on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol "NVCR." We were incorporated in the Bailiwick of Jersey in 2000. Daily management and control of the Company are located in Switzerland, with additional operating centers located around the world.

headings: Risks relating to our business and our Products
To date, we have generated only occasional and intermittent operating profits, and we have a history of incurring substantial operating losses.
Our clinical studies could be delayed or otherwise adversely affected by many factors, including difficulties in enrolling patients.
The success of our business may be dependent on the actions of our collaborative partners.
Failure to secure and maintain adequate coverage and reimbursement from third-party payers could adversely affect acceptance of our Products and reduce our revenues.
We may not be successful in securing and maintaining reimbursement codes necessary to facilitate accurate and timely billing for our Products or physician services attendant to our Products.
There is no assurance that Medicare or the Medicare Administrative Contractors will provide, or continue to provide, coverage or adequate payment rates for our Products.

We depend on single-source suppliers for some of our components. The loss of these suppliers could prevent or delay shipments of our Products, delay our clinical studies or otherwise adversely affect our business.
Continued testing of our Products may not yield successful results and could reveal currently unknown aspects or safety hazards associated with our Products.
As we expand, we may experience difficulties managing our growth.
Other future litigation and regulatory actions could have a material adverse impact on the Company.
Global economic, political, industry and environmental conditions constantly change and unfavorable conditions may have a material adverse effect on our business and results of operations.
paragraphs: An investment in our ordinary shares involves a high degree of risk. Investors and prospective investors should carefully consider all of the information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the risks and uncertainties described below. Any of the following risks could have a material adverse effect on our business, prospects, financial condition and results of operations. In any such case, the trading price of our ordinary shares could decline, and you could lose all or part of your investment. In assessing these risks, you should also refer to the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our consolidated financial statements and the related notes thereto.

Our business and prospects depend heavily on Optune Gio, which is currently approved only for the treatment of GBM, Optune Lua, which is currently approved for the treatment of NSCLC and MPM in certain countries and Optune Pax, which is currently approved for the treatment of pancreatic cancer in the U.S. If we are unable to increase sales of our Products, obtain further regulatory approvals and commercialize our Products for the treatment of additional indications, or are significantly delayed or limited in doing so, our business and prospects will be materially harmed.

To date we have received FDA regulatory approval under the PMA pathway and certain approvals in other jurisdictions for the use of Optune Gio for the treatment of adult patients with newly diagnosed GBM when used together with certain forms of chemotherapy and for the treatment of adult patients with recurrent GBM as monotherapy. Optune Gio has a CE mark affixed for the treatment of GBM in the EU and Switzerland. Optune Lua is approved by the FDA under the PMA pathway for adults with metastatic NSCLC who have progressed on or after a platinum-based regimen, together with docetaxel or PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors. We have also received FDA approval under the HDE pathway to market Optune Lua for unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic, MPM when used together with standard chemotherapies. Optune Lua is also CE Certified for NSCLC and MPM in the EU and Switzerland. In addition, we received regulatory approval for Optune Lua for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable advanced/recurrent NSCLC concurrent with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors following progression on or after a platinum-based regimen in Japan. Most recently, we have received FDA regulatory approval under the PMA pathway for the use of Optune Pax for the treatment of locally advanced pancreatic cancer. However, such approvals and maintaining the CE Certificates of Conformity, and related CE marking, of our Products, as applicable, do not guarantee future revenues for these indications. Further, until we receive FDA and analogous approval in other jurisdictions for the use of our Products for other indications (including for NSCLC and pancratic cancer pending obtaining widespread reimbursement agreements), almost all of our revenues will derive from sales and royalties from sales of Optune Gio for the treatment of newly diagnosed and recurrent GBM. The commercial success of our Products and our ability to generate and maintain revenues from the sale of our Products will depend on a number of factors, including:
•our ability to develop and obtain additional regulatory approvals and further commercialize our Products for additional indications;
•our ability to expand into new markets and future indications;
•the acceptance of our Products by patients and the healthcare community, including physicians and third-party payers (both private and governmental), as therapeutically effective and safe;

We encourage you to read this MD&A in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto included in Part II, Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Please refer to the information under the heading "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" elsewhere in this report. References to the words "we," "our," "us," and the "Company" in this report refer to NovoCure Limited, including its consolidated subsidiaries.

Our revenues are primarily derived from patients using our Products in our active markets. We charge for treatment with our Products on a monthly basis. Our potential net revenues per patient are determined by our ability to secure payment, the monthly fee we collect and the number of months that the patient remains on therapy.
We also receive revenues pursuant to the Zai Agreement. For additional information regarding the Zai Agreement, see Note 12 to the Consolidated Financial Statements.
We contract with third parties to manufacture our Products. Our cost of revenues is primarily comprised of the following:
•depreciation expense for the field equipment, including the electric field generator used by patients; and
•personnel and overhead costs such as facilities, freight and depreciation of property, plant and equipment associated with managing our inventory, warehousing and order fulfillment functions.

Our operating expenses consist of research, development and clinical studies, sales and marketing and general and administrative expenses. Personnel costs are a significant component for each category of operating expenses and consist of wages, benefits and bonuses. Personnel costs also include share-based compensation.
Research, development and clinical studies

Our research, development and clinical studies activity is focused on advancing TTFields therapy through clinical studies across multiple solid tumor types and improving the efficacy and usability of our devices. Research, development and clinical studies costs, including direct and allocated expenses, are expensed as incurred and consist primarily of the following:

•costs to conduct research, product development and clinical study activity through agreements with contract research organizations and other third parties;

paragraphs: 本公司為一間全球性腫瘤治療公司，擁有專屬的平台技術，稱為腫瘤治療電場（"TTFields"），這些電場會施加物理力量以殺死癌細胞。我們的療法是透過醫療器材來提供。我們的重點為推動Optune Gio®、Optune Lua®與Optune Pax®這三種商業化的TTFields治療器材的商業採用，取得在新適應症（例如非小細胞肺腺癌（"NSCLC"）腦轉移）中行銷TTFields治療器材的監管批准，並推進臨牀與產品開發計畫，以延長某些最惡性腫瘤的總體存活率。

Optune Gio®已獲得美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）依照預市批准（"PMA"）途徑批准，用於治療新診斷的膠質母細胞瘤（"GBM"）成人患者，與替莫唑胺（一種化學治療藥物）同時使用，以及用於GBM成人患者在化學治療後確認為復發時作為單一療法。我們也擁有CE認證，可在歐盟（"EU"）行銷Optune Gio®用於治療GBM，同時也獲得英國（"UK"）、日本、加拿大及其他某些國家的批准或當地登記。

Optune Lua®已獲得FDA依照PMA途徑批准，用於治療與PD-1/PD-L1抑制劑同時使用，或在經過含鉑療法後進展的成人患者之轉移性NSCLC。我們也擁有CE認證，可在歐盟行銷Optune Lua®與PD-1/PD-L1抑制劑或docetaxel同時使用，用於治療轉移性NSCLC。此外，我們也獲得日本批准，用於治療與PD-1/PD-L1抑制劑同時使用，用於轉移性NSCLC成人患者之不可切除的晚期/復發性NSCLC，且在經過含鉑療法後進展。
Optune Lua®也已獲得FDA依照人道醫療器材免除（"HDE"）途徑批准，用於治療與標準化學治療藥物同時使用，用於成人患者之惡性胸膜間皮瘤或胸膜間皮瘤（合稱為"MPM"）。我們也擁有CE認證在歐盟，並獲得批准或當地登記，可在某些其他國家行銷Optune Lua®用於治療MPM。
Optune Pax®已獲得FDA依照PMA途徑批准，用於治療與吉西他濱與 nab-paclitaxel 同時使用，用於局部晚期胰腺癌成人患者。我們正在尋求在其他國家行銷Optune Pax®的監管批准。
我們在全球多個國家行銷我們的產品，我們的收入主要來自美國、德國、法國與日本使用Optune Gio®的銷售。我們正在積極評估擴展Optune Gio®、Optune Lua®與Optune Pax®在其他國際市場的接觸機會。
我們已與公共與私人支付者建立覆蓋政策，用於在現有市場中使用Optune Gio®。我們正在積極尋求與支付者建立覆蓋政策，以擴展Optune Lua®與Optune Pax®的接觸，同時我們將根據適用情況，個別案例向支付者開立帳單並尋求報銷。

2025年9月，我們在2025年美國放射腫瘤學會年會上，發表了Phase 3 METIS臨牀試驗的最終數據，評估TTFields治療與最佳支持性照護（BSC）用於治療1至10個腦轉移的成人患者（n=298）之NSCLC，這些患者在立體放射外科手術後接受治療。METIS試驗的主要終點被定義為腦內進展時間（TTIP），從首次SRS治療日期計算至腦內進展或神經學死亡，以先發生者為準。透過Fine–Gray方法計算競爭風險時，與僅接受BSC治療的患者相比，接受TTFields治療與BSC治療的患者，腦內進展風險降低了28%（HR=0.72，p=0.044）。接受TTFields治療與BSC治療的患者的中位腦內進展時間為15.0個月，而僅接受BSC治療的患者的中位腦內進展時間為7.5個月。
2025 年 12 月我們提交了 PMA 的最後一模組，尋求在建議品牌名稱 Optune Mya® 下的核准。PMA 已經被 FDA 接收並列入檔案，目前正進行實質審查。
我們相信 TTFields 療法的物理作用機制及由此引發的受損細胞下游細胞過程，可能廣泛適用於實體腫瘤癌症。我們有數個進行中及近期完成的臨牀試驗，進一步探討 TTFields 療法的應用，包括在膠質母細胞瘤的 Phase 3 TRIDENT 和 KEYNOTE D58 試驗，NSCLC 的 Phase 3 LUNAR-2 試驗，以及胰腺癌的 Phase 2 PANOVA-4 試驗。
以及 Phase 2 PANOVA-4 試驗在胰腺癌。
我們有數個產品開發計畫正在進行中，這些計畫旨在優化 TTFields 對目標腫瘤的傳遞，並提升患者的使用便利性。我們的智慧財產權組合包含數百項已發明的專利，以及許多正在世界各地申請中的專利。我們相信我們擁有在腫瘤學領域商業化我們產品的全球權利，並在未來持續尋找創新方式改進我們產品的過程中，處於有利位置。
2018 年，我們授予 Zai Lab (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. ("Zai") 一項許可，允許其在中國、香港、澳門及臺灣（"亞太大陸"）商業化我們的產品，根據一份許可與合作協議（"Zai 協議"）。Zai 協議也建立了開發合作夥伴關係，旨在加速 TTFields 治療在多種實體腫瘤癌症適應症的發展。如需更多資訊，請參閱合併財務報表的附註 12。
我們的普通股在 NASDAQ Global Select Market 以符號 "NVCR" 賣出。我們於 2000 年在 Bailiwick of Jersey 成立。公司的日常管理和控制位於瑞士，並在全球其他地區設有額外的運營中心。

paragraphs: 管理階層對於財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析（"MD&A"）旨在提供資訊，協助您更深入瞭解與評估本公司的財務狀況與營運成果。我們建議您配合本年度10-K申報表第二部分第8項所載之合併財務報表及其附註，一併閱讀本MD&A。本討論包含風險與不確定性之預測性陳述。請參閱本報告其他部分標題為"預測性陳述之警示說明"之資訊。本報告中所使用之"我們"、"我們的"、"我們公司"及"本公司"等詞彙，均指NovoCure Limited，包括其合併子公司。
我們之營業收入主要來自於患者在本公司的活躍市場中使用我們之產品。我們針對患者使用我們之產品收取每月費用。我們之潛在每位患者淨收入，取決於我們能否取得付款、我們所收取之每月費用以及患者持續接受治療之月數。
我們亦根據Zai契約取得收入。有關Zai契約之更多資訊，請參閱合併財務報表之附註12。

•場地設備之折舊費用，包括患者使用之電場產生器；以及

我們之營運費用包含研究、開發與臨牀試驗、銷售與行銷及一般及行政費用。人力成本為各類營運費用之重要組成部分，包含薪資、福利與獎金。人力成本亦包含股票激勵報酬。
研究、開發與臨牀試驗
本公司之研究、開發及臨牀研究活動，係著重於透過多種實體腫瘤類型之臨牀研究，推進TTFields療法，並提升本公司產品之療效與易用性。研究、開發及臨牀研究費用，包括直接及分攤費用，係於發生時認列，主要包含以下項目：

其他未來的訴訟及監管行動可能對本公司產生重大不利影響。
全球經濟、政治、產業及環境條件持續變動，不利條件可能對本公司營運及營業成果產生重大不利影響。
paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險。投資人及潛在投資人應仔細審閱本年度報告表10-K所載全部資訊，包括下列所描述的風險與不確定性。任何下列風險都可能對本公司業務、前景、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。在這種情況下，本公司普通股的交易價格可能下跌，投資人可能損失全部或部分投資。評估這些風險時，投資人應同時參考本年度報告表10-K所載其他資訊，包括本公司合併財務報表及其相關附註。
本公司業務與前景高度依賴Optune Gio，目前僅核准用於治療GBM，Optune Lua目前核准用於治療NSCLC及MPM於某些國家，Optune Pax目前核准用於治療美國的胰臟癌。若本公司無法增加產品銷售、取得進一步的監管核准並商業化產品用於治療其他適應症，或在進行這些事項時遭遇顯著延宕或限制，將對本公司業務與前景造成重大損害。

截至目前為止，本公司已獲得FDA根據PMA途徑核准，以及某些司法管轄區核准，用於治療新診斷的GBM成人患者，與特定形式的化療藥物合用，以及治療復發性GBM成人患者作為單一療法。Optune Gio在歐盟與瑞士取得CE標章，用於治療GBM。Optune Lua已獲得FDA根據PMA途徑核准，用於治療已對鉑基療法產生耐藥性或治療後的NSCLC成人患者，與docetaxel或PD-1/PD-L1抑制劑合用。本公司也已獲得FDA根據HDE途徑核准，用於市場銷售Optune Lua，用於治療無法手術切除、局部晚期或轉移性MPM患者，與標準化療藥物合用。Optune Lua在歐盟與瑞士也取得CE認證，用於NSCLC與MPM。此外，本公司也獲得核准，用於治療日本的NSCLC成人患者，無法手術切除且為晚期/復發性NSCLC，與PD-1/PD-L1抑制劑合用，治療後對鉑基療法產生耐藥性。最近，本公司已獲得FDA根據PMA途徑核准，用於治療局部晚期胰臟癌。然而，這些核准與維持產品的CE認證及相關CE標章，並不能保證未來這些適應症的收入。此外，直到本公司獲得FDA及其他司法管轄區核准，用於治療其他適應症（包括NSCLC與胰臟癌，待取得廣泛的報銷協議），幾乎所有收入將來自Optune Gio的銷售與銷售 royalties，用於治療新診斷與復發性GBM。產品的商業成功與本公司產生並維持產品銷售收入的能力，將取決於多項因素，包括：
•本公司開發並取得額外監管核准，進一步商業化產品用於其他適應症的能力；
•本公司擴展至新市場與未來適應症的能力；
•產品被患者與醫療界（包括醫師與第三方支付者，無論為私人或政府機構）接受，視為治療有效且安全。
